question: A 23-year-old woman goes to the emergency room because she is very nervous after an argument with her partner. In his clinical history several similar demands are reflected in the previous year, in two of them after an autolytic gesture. There are also frequent conflicts in relationships, work changes and family discussions. She says she feels misunderstood by everyone including the psychiatrists who care for her. The diagnosis would be:
analysis: Based on the clinical history provided, the most likely diagnosis for the 23-year-old woman would be Borderline Personality Disorder. The recurrent demands for attention, self-harm behaviors, conflicts in relationships, and feelings of being misunderstood are characteristic features of Borderline Personality Disorder.
